Actual source dispatch, atomic fixed metadata/results/source/accounting, effective reservation expiry, production providers and central validation remain pending. Actual Worker TIME_FENCE now routes immutable replay before first authentication and atomically commits nondecreasing fixed metadata/latest proof, SYSTEM/POSITION, source and exact root-owned fixed-record fees. Backend measures and guards a dedicated fixed projection; ordinary business edits still cannot address it. Eight necessary development checks passed, including ACK UNKNOWN, exact eight-record write/seven-record rejection, same-position replay, lower fences, external failure classification and local reopen. Effective reservation expiry/materialization, production authority providers, full recovery/config/migration and central validation remain unfinished. Target reservations now expose a read-only TIME_FENCE effective status in the same guarded Query view and enforce it in Commit/Cancel/Reschedule. Still-materialized RESERVED at expiry <= committed watermark is effectively EXPIRED; prior terminal states and immutable Prepare receipts remain. Four real Worker development scenarios passed inclusive boundaries with broker time before expiry, QUERY/stale-view/snapshot checks, proof-resolver bypass, command replay/CAS and unchanged physical projections/owner/quota. Bounded materialization, complete Close overlays, public Query/upload, production providers/factory and central validation remain unfinished. Bounded single-reservation expiry materialization now uses a distinct TargetQuotaMutation field5, mutually exclusive with Claim field4 and sharing local ordinal order without advancing source. It atomically writes EXPIRED primary/lookup, deletes expiry, retains the original payload owner and applies exact two-counter/total/aggregate fees with mandatory read/quota/commit authority. Five minimal development checks passed: four real Worker/Store flows and unchanged independent bookkeeping vectors. Retry is a guarded zero-write no-op. GC discovery/cursor/WorkClass, full Close ordering, production providers/factory/reader activation and complete recovery/migration/central validation remain unfinished. Target expiry discovery and GC WorkClass are now implemented: one guarded candidate per action, committed-fence sweep cutoff, shared discovery/query/accounting read budget, mandatory read/quota/write guards, process-local continuation with full reset at range end. CLOSED Target is explicitly deferred and revisited, not terminalized. Four minimal real Worker/Store cases passed, including Owner loss and budget zero-write, external write-authority failure classification, source-preserving atomic expiry, and a real Prepare inserted behind the cursor discovered after sweep reset. Production trigger/providers/factory, complete Close ordering, all recovery/migration and centralized validation remain unfinished. Reservation Close/fence ordering now uses mandatory TargetReservationControls across Query, Source Command and expiry GC. Its process-local authority response binds the original Target/binding/lineage, full earliest applicable Close source and fence at Close: Close-first stays logically ABANDONED despite later fences; expiry-first remains EXPIRED and can materialize. CLOSED without historical evidence fails closed. Four minimal Worker/Store scenarios passed with injected historical Close responses, including stable closed commands, zero-write GC deferral and source-preserving expiry. This is not a durable Close writer or historical authority certification. Durable markers/first-Close providers/ABANDONED materialization, production assembly, recovery/migration and central validation remain unfinished. Actual Worker Target Close now validates a platform-signed complete frozen Shard set, exact registration/ControlRef and current queue incarnation/version, then atomically stores the first NV39 marker with its historical fence, CLOSED/null-head queue, immutable results and exact source accounting. Reservation closure reads the durable global marker and combines mandatory remaining scope evidence. Twelve necessary development checks passed; existing messages/candidates and payload phases remain intact. Production complete-coverage/history providers, bounded closure materialization and aggregate phase transfer, admitted-work retirement, full recovery/config/migration and centralized validation remain pending. A bounded TargetReservationClosureStore now materializes an already accepted Close-before-expiry decision without waiting for TIME_FENCE: durable NV38 closure evidence and typed local ordinal field6, dual ID/expiry/retained owner plus exact counter/total/aggregate accounting, preserving source and Prepare receipt. Query retains the durable cause and post-CAS commands preserve the closed outcome. Six necessary development checks passed. Persistent Close cursor/GC scheduling, aggregate phase transfer, admitted retirement, production providers/config/factory, full recovery/migration and centralized validation remain pending. A Target-ordered active reservation ID index now tracks physically RESERVED NV38 records across Prepare, Commit, Cancel, expiry and Close materialization with exact state accounting. Read-authorized bounded discovery checks the accepted Close marker, closed queue, source/lineage/incarnation and index/dual-ID identity without scanning the whole Shard. Four necessary Worker/Store scenarios passed. Durable NV40 Close cursor now binds the first marker and lineage, advances with the first active reservation terminal batch, and supports a separate field7 empty-scan completion; four Worker scenarios and protocol checks passed. A Target-specific GC WorkClass action now rediscovers NV40 under one read budget and routes the effective Close/expiry terminal decision; four real Worker parameter scenarios passed Close-first, Owner loss, completed replay and absent marker. A second Target now exercises actual grant, source-accounted queue fixture, signed Close and empty-scan GC completion: write-authority failure is zero-write, then field7 plus Target/mirror counters, total and aggregate commits in five native writes without advancing source; repeated action is zero-write. A bounded NV40 Target sweep now skips one completed Target or processes one open Target per GC action, wraps at range end, and reconstructs its process-local scan from durable NV40 after restart. Four real Worker cases pass two-Target discovery, completion skip, bounded-read failure and foreign cursor rejection. A guarded, bounded local RocksDB reopen now reads the fixed NV31 bookkeeping anchor and NV33 root, checks aggregate/source frontier, reconstructs backend from persisted incarnation/lineage and lets the new GC executor skip two COMPLETE NV40 Targets and complete a third OPEN empty Target with field7 and five native writes while source frontier stays unchanged. Target source runtime accepts the reopened root; a wrong tenant is rejected. Its Close GC factory now binds to the same WorkClass graph and Owner/Store guard: four local in-memory lease CAS cases reject an old queued GC with zero writes, then let a new Owner epoch reopen and complete the OPEN empty Target. A caller-driven bounded maintenance turn now alternates Close and ordinary expiry, retaining the exact pending task across a small shared budget; four local cases complete three Close targets and four empty expiry scans with five native cursor writes and unchanged source frontier. A single-shard Target Worker entry now binds the source loop and GC to the exact Store, shared resources and WorkClass graph, gating both turns through resource admission; four local Store cases exercise GC through this entry. A Target fleet now rotates source and GC turns independently across exact-graph unique Shards; a two-shard local ordering/failure test and the real Store single-shard fleet path passed. An explicit fixed-delay maintenance loop now supplies bounded GC ticks when started; a local scheduled-failure and quiescent-close test passed. A paused Target Worker can now settle only its already queued GC action; four local Store cases retain the pending task across a small budget, clear it without a new submission, and leave native sequence unchanged. A local Target Owner drain now rejects pending source entries, settles queued GC, CASes the exact Owner to DRAINING, flushes/closes the Store, releases the exact lease and closes source; replacement Owner is preserved and uncertain writes use a distinct close-first release path. Four actual Store parameter cases passed. The host still must stop the loop and resolve pending ACKs; checkpoint, real Oxia/Broker response-loss and takeover, production recovery and centralized validation remain open. Real Oxia/Broker takeover and active-reservation continuation after reopen, production event-loop triggering and measured cross-Target fairness, controlled pre-index format-2 backfill, closed aggregate transfer, production providers, full recovery/Broker/migration and centralized validation remain pending.

slices.title: 公平性唤醒和后续语义
slices.validationScope: Existing evidence applies only to its recorded source and original slice scope; no certification of subsequent runtime integration.
slices.progress: Design §10.5 fixes the baseline physical Target weight, lazy frozen-byte cost, source-Shard rotation, bounded recovery first pass, ordinary-before-early rule, process-only fairness state and conditional visit bound. A real Owner-guarded Worker probe derives one selected head's execution bytes and DRR cost from frozen Message, binding and incarnation artifacts; the Worker can refresh an exact Target's head after Claim. Paged scans carry Store incarnation/native-sequence cuts and a protected end-cut detects source/Claim changes. The Host can now assemble a bounded process-only inventory from all admitted Shards, grouping the same physical Target once and refusing incomplete pages, changed cuts or changed Shard membership. Deterministic assembly tests cover grouping and rejection; two independent format-2 RocksDB Shards also verify one physical Target across real paged reads and refusal after a native write changes a page cut. Their queues and read guards are fixtures, not a real multi-Shard Worker/Host Claim path. A process-local ordinary-due DRR now accepts only a complete Host-bound inventory with rechecked Shard membership and Store cuts, gives each physical Target one credit share, lazily probes selected heads, rotates source Shards/domains only after a successful durable Host Claim, and returns after at most one Claim per call. Focused seam tests cover byte credit, per-turn budget, failed Claim cursor preservation, stale-head refresh, invalid send envelope and an explicit READ_INCOMPLETE result that retains the head and lets another Target progress. A bounded process-local recovery first pass now freezes current ordinary eligibility from live head/cost/permit checks before any Claim, rechecks Store cuts, prevents repeat service until the frozen members claim or become unavailable, and does not reopen for newly available Targets. Deterministic tests cover visit/read-budget continuation, cut change rejection, large-cost credit waiting, blocked-member removal and the post-pass return to the normal ring. One real single-Shard RocksDB Schedule path now rebuilds the Host inventory, freezes the recovery first pass, claims through ordinary DRR and Host admission, and continues later source Command and reopen audit in the two Claim branches of the four-case parameterized Store test; its maintenance timer is controlled by the test. Two real format-2 Worker Stores now enter one Host inventory for the same physical Target. Each receives an actual Schedule head; the recovery first pass freezes one physical Target and two ordinary DRR turns commit Claims in source-Shard order, each leaving the other Store native sequence unchanged. A deterministic continuously eligible three-Target/two-source selection test now checks the N*ceil(Cmax/Q) Target and S*N*ceil(Cmax/Q) source visit bounds across 48 one-visit turns. A failed Claim now leaves that visit's DRR credit unearned; one deterministic regression verifies a larger successor head still waits for its own credit. Real continuous Host/Store fairness remains unverified. Recovery-first-pass behavior under Owner/Store changes, dynamic Target admission, Native/Producer selection and E1/E4/E5/E6 integration remain unimplemented or unverified.
